newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT--Octel raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT--Octel raised to buy.

text.p: Hambrecht & Quist raised Octel Communications Corp to buy from hold.
--raised its fourth quarter earnings estimate to $0.36 a share from $0.33 a share and revenue estimate to $183.4 million from $177.4 million.
--raised its calendar 1997 earnings estimate to $0.93 a share from $0.90 a share and revenue estimate to $631.5 million from $625.5 million.
--said the change followed meetings with Octel management that led H&Q to believe Octel may return to the sort of robust profits it had before it reported its September 1996 quarter.
